title: Morning Keeps Its Promise
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people wandered far away,
And missed Him more each day;
"Come, let us go back to the Lord,"
They said, and turned His way.

[Chorus]
As sure as morning, He will come,
As sure as morning light;
The sun comes back, the sky turns pink,
And everything is bright.

[Verse 2]
"He'll heal us up," the people said,
"He'll wrap each hurt we show,"
A bandage on a scraped-up knee,
He helps the hurting go.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
He comes to us just like the rain
That farmers watch and wait;
It falls right when the plants are dry,
His help is never late.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Scout watched the sky turn pink, and then
The sun came up that day;
If you feel far away from Him,
Come back to Him and pray.

[Chorus]
mood: Sunrise music. A soft, even ukulele strum that starts low and quiet, like the first gray light before the sun, and lifts a little with each verse as the sky turns pink. An upright bass walking slowly underneath, steady as a sun that never forgets to come. Unhurried and warm, and by the last chorus it is the middle of a clear morning, bright but still gentle.
